title: ui: the permission-set pages' holder pick on Add still lacks two pins (one candidate, an empty list), re-offers the refused environment pick, and keys an id-less grant as "undefined"
body:
domain:ui#6 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgUAXJEaRNwDiLuAvEZ

Follow-up of #32774 (PR #32800). Part of #31527 (ADR-0150). Visible only once #31698 PR-2 lets two packages hold one permission-set name.

Filing category: ② follow-up of a reviewed PR. reach: the epic red-line read of PR #32800 at head `c2e74354` (comment 6834657181, PASS-with-nits, no extra round by the #31527 rule). Line numbers are to be re-read on `main` once PR #32800 lands.

## 维护者速读

PR #32800 让权限集页面在 Add 被服务端以「多个包持有」拒绝时，也弹出持有者选择，并把不归任何持有者的授权单独列出。复读确认行为正确，但还缺两个测试：只有一个候选时不能自动替人选并重发；候选列表为空时不弹选择。另外，选「本环境」候选后重发的请求和被拒的一样，会再被拒一次；没有 id 的授权行会被记成字符串 "undefined"；正文里的测试数没有点名套件；表里只在 Add 下写了读扁平 body，克隆和激活其实也读了。都不放宽服务端判定。

## What happens (at `c2e74354`)

1. No pin covers a one-candidate refusal on Add: a silent pick-and-re-send there would go unnoticed (the ablation "auto-pick only on a one-element list" stayed green, 0/79). The code is right today.
2. `details.candidates: []` has no explicit pin; only the missing-details case covers it.
3. The PR body says "14 suites, 156 tests" without naming them; the count is not reproducible from the diff.
4. Picking the environment candidate on Add re-sends with no package, which is the request that was refused, so the same pick comes back: harmless, but a dead end.
5. An unresolved row whose grant has no `id` gets the grant id string `"undefined"` (the main rows on `main` share the pattern).
6. `holderCandidatesOf` now reads the flat `/data` body for the clone and activation doors too; the PR's table mentions it only under Add.

## Expected

- Pins: one candidate ⇒ one button and zero `create` calls until it is clicked; an empty candidates list ⇒ no pick, the server's sentence only.
- The environment candidate on Add either addresses the environment's own set in a way the door accepts, or is not offered there with the reason said; ⛔ never resolved by order.
- A grant row with no `id` is shown without a Remove (or skipped with a note), never keyed as `"undefined"`.
- Items 3 and 6 are documentation: name the suites in the next PR's body and note the clone/activation reading where it applies.
- One holder: requests and screens unchanged (CONTROL).

Reader who acts: `domain:ui` (`@object-ui/app-shell`, `views/metadata-admin/`). Triage decides the grade; it sits on the #31527 release line after PR #32800.

Dedupe: `repo:objectstack-ai/objectstack is:issue is:open holderCandidatesOf` → 1 hit (#32774, the parent). The nearest are #32774 (the parent), #32795 (the `permission-ref` widget's edges), #32770 and #32537; none covers the Add pick's pins or the id-less row.
